units.rawText: As system voices clamor, Undine slowly opens her eyes.
units.displayText: As system voices clamor, Undine slowly opens her eyes.

spans.text: As system voices clamor, Undine slowly opens her eyes.

units.rawText: Ahh...
units.displayText: Ahh...

spans.text: Ahh...

units.rawText: (This is... De Lacey's repair center?)
units.displayText: This is... De Lacey's repair center?

spans.text: This is... De Lacey's repair center?

units.rawText: Tsk... ouch...
units.displayText: Tsk... ouch...

spans.text: Tsk... ouch...

units.rawText: Ah, Unni, you're up! Thank goodness, it looks like the repairs went well!
units.displayText: Ah, Unni, you're up! Thank goodness, it looks like the repairs went well!

spans.text: Ah, Unni, you're up! Thank goodness, it looks like the repairs went well!

units.rawText: De Lacey, what happened?
units.displayText: De Lacey, what happened?

spans.text: De Lacey, what happened?

units.rawText: Wait, where are they? How are they? Are they well?
units.displayText: Wait, where are they? How are they? Are they well?

spans.text: Wait, where are they? How are they? Are they well?

units.rawText: Hang on, don't move!
units.displayText: Hang on, don't move!

spans.text: Hang on, don't move!

units.rawText: Your wounds were far too severe. Many parts have been switched out for new ones, and not all of them are calibrated properly.
units.displayText: Your wounds were far too severe. Many parts have been switched out for new ones, and not all of them are calibrated properly.

spans.text: Your wounds were far too severe. Many parts have been switched out for new ones, and not all of them are calibrated properly.

units.rawText: Then... what about them?
units.displayText: Then... what about them?

spans.text: Then... what about them?

units.rawText: They are... not doing so well either, but you were far and beyond busted up the worst.
units.displayText: They are... not doing so well either, but you were far and beyond busted up the worst.

spans.text: They are... not doing so well either, but you were far and beyond busted up the worst.

units.rawText: We all got a scare when you guys came in. You were all wounded really badly, especially you. Almost all the systems were damaged, and your legs were gone too.
units.displayText: We all got a scare when you guys came in. You were all wounded really badly, especially you. Almost all the systems were damaged, and your legs were gone too.

spans.text: We all got a scare when you guys came in. You were all wounded really badly, especially you. Almost all the systems were damaged, and your legs were gone too.

units.rawText: They went into hibernation soon after they got back here, and are still being repaired.
units.displayText: They went into hibernation soon after they got back here, and are still being repaired.

spans.text: They went into hibernation soon after they got back here, and are still being repaired.

units.rawText: What about now? Don't tell me something unforeseen has happened with them.
units.displayText: What about now? Don't tell me something unforeseen has happened with them.

spans.text: What about now? Don't tell me something unforeseen has happened with them.

units.rawText: No, nothing of the sort, so relax. You woke up first because they asked me to help you first.
units.displayText: No, nothing of the sort, so relax. You woke up first because they asked me to help you first.

spans.text: No, nothing of the sort, so relax. You woke up first because they asked me to help you first.

units.rawText: They... are my most important...
units.displayText: They... are my most important...

spans.text: They... are my most important...

units.rawText: With a weight lifted off her chest, the emotional signals she blocked off previously come pouring back. Fear, terror, sadness... Undine covers her face, crying to her heart's content.
units.displayText: With a weight lifted off her chest, the emotional signals she blocked off previously come pouring back. Fear, terror, sadness... Undine covers her face, crying to her heart's content.

spans.text: With a weight lifted off her chest, the emotional signals she blocked off previously come pouring back. Fear, terror, sadness... Undine covers her face, crying to her heart's content.

units.rawText: Thank... the heavens... Sniff...
units.displayText: Thank... the heavens... Sniff...

spans.text: Thank... the heavens... Sniff...

units.rawText: Unni...
units.displayText: Unni...

spans.text: Unni...

units.rawText: I-I'm alright. What else happened after we left?
units.displayText: I-I'm alright. What else happened after we left?

spans.text: I-I'm alright. What else happened after we left?

units.rawText: About that...
units.displayText: About that...

spans.text: About that...

units.rawText: I had a deeper look into the modifications made on you. Since the data on you had been encrypted by someone, I figured that someone had been doing something dodgy and wanted to tell you earlier.
units.displayText: I had a deeper look into the modifications made on you. Since the data on you had been encrypted by someone, I figured that someone had been doing something dodgy and wanted to tell you earlier.

spans.text: I had a deeper look into the modifications made on you. Since the data on you had been encrypted by someone, I figured that someone had been doing something dodgy and wanted to tell you earlier.

units.rawText: But I had no way to contact you, and then a few days later we got the news that you... had been sent to the recycling yard.
units.displayText: But I had no way to contact you, and then a few days later we got the news that you... had been sent to the recycling yard.

spans.text: But I had no way to contact you, and then a few days later we got the news that you... had been sent to the recycling yard.

units.rawText: Something dodgy? Is that why their neural capacity is so small?
units.displayText: Something dodgy? Is that why their neural capacity is so small?

spans.text: Something dodgy? Is that why their neural capacity is so small?

units.rawText: Exactly, the extra encrypted data inside their neural clouds was a backdoor program for controlling them and sending messages.
units.displayText: Exactly, the extra encrypted data inside their neural clouds was a backdoor program for controlling them and sending messages.

spans.text: Exactly, the extra encrypted data inside their neural clouds was a backdoor program for controlling them and sending messages.

units.rawText: And what you said before about the help from Mr. Ricardo... I never asked him to do any of that. I initially thought that you had a misunderstanding from what he told you, but after investigating, it turns out that list might have made its way to you through him so you could approach your target.
units.displayText: And what you said before about the help from Mr. Ricardo... I never asked him to do any of that. I initially thought that you had a misunderstanding from what he told you, but after investigating, it turns out that list might have made its way to you through him so you could approach your target.

spans.text: And what you said before about the help from Mr. Ricardo... I never asked him to do any of that. I initially thought that you had a misunderstanding from what he told you, but after investigating, it turns out that list might have made its way to you through him so you could approach your target.

units.rawText: Hey, little Doll. I heard that you've still not found suitable work, and De Lacey asked me to take a look.
units.displayText: Hey, little Doll. I heard that you've still not found suitable work, and De Lacey asked me to take a look.

spans.text: Hey, little Doll. I heard that you've still not found suitable work, and De Lacey asked me to take a look.

units.rawText: Mr. Ricardo? My gratitude for yours and De Lacey's concern. Then, is this list...
units.displayText: Mr. Ricardo? My gratitude for yours and De Lacey's concern. Then, is this list...

spans.text: Mr. Ricardo? My gratitude for yours and De Lacey's concern. Then, is this list...

units.rawText: Yeah, it's a list of clients with their contact details. You have a good look, they're all big names with big money.
units.displayText: Yeah, it's a list of clients with their contact details. You have a good look, they're all big names with big money.

spans.text: Yeah, it's a list of clients with their contact details. You have a good look, they're all big names with big money.

units.rawText: <size=28>Come to speak of it, it's all thanks to you, too. If you had never asked Mr. Ricardo to look for a list of possible clients... There's no saying where we'd be doing right now.</size>
units.displayText: Come to speak of it, it's all thanks to you, too. If you had never asked Mr. Ricardo to look for a list of possible clients... There's no saying where we'd be doing right now.

spans.text: Come to speak of it, it's all thanks to you, too. If you had never asked Mr. Ricardo to look for a list of possible clients... There's no saying where we'd be doing right now.

units.rawText: Me? When did I... are you misremembering, perhaps?
units.displayText: Me? When did I... are you misremembering, perhaps?

spans.text: Me? When did I... are you misremembering, perhaps?

units.rawText: Of course... I should've known that in that list, only that Dario would give us work!
units.displayText: Of course... I should've known that in that list, only that Dario would give us work!

spans.text: Of course... I should've known that in that list, only that Dario would give us work!

units.rawText: Ugh!
units.displayText: Ugh!

spans.text: Ugh!

units.rawText: Unni! Don't move around!
units.displayText: Unni! Don't move around!

spans.text: Unni! Don't move around!

units.rawText: Your parts have not been calibrated, and the same goes for the pain modules; moving any more might really hurt.
units.displayText: Your parts have not been calibrated, and the same goes for the pain modules; moving any more might really hurt.

spans.text: Your parts have not been calibrated, and the same goes for the pain modules; moving any more might really hurt.

units.rawText: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt anymore. De Lacey, don't worry about others so much. With how jumpy you are, someone who's perfectly well would be convinced they were mortally ill.
units.displayText: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt anymore. De Lacey, don't worry about others so much. With how jumpy you are, someone who's perfectly well would be convinced they were mortally ill.

spans.text: Don't worry, it doesn't hurt anymore. De Lacey, don't worry about others so much. With how jumpy you are, someone who's perfectly well would be convinced they were mortally ill.

units.rawText: <size=28>Your help, we will...</size>
units.displayText: Your help, we will...

spans.text: Your help, we will...

units.rawText: Hmm? I can't really hear you.
units.displayText: Hmm? I can't really hear you.

spans.text: Hmm? I can't really hear you.

units.rawText: I mean to say, we'll do everything we can to return the money for these parts quickly. You'd do well to avoid contact with us for the time being.
units.displayText: I mean to say, we'll do everything we can to return the money for these parts quickly. You'd do well to avoid contact with us for the time being.

spans.text: I mean to say, we'll do everything we can to return the money for these parts quickly. You'd do well to avoid contact with us for the time being.

units.rawText: No matter how you want to put it, the whole deal with us leaking secrets has spread to even here... We can't stay here any longer. If we want to survive, we'll have to make a new start someplace else.
units.displayText: No matter how you want to put it, the whole deal with us leaking secrets has spread to even here... We can't stay here any longer. If we want to survive, we'll have to make a new start someplace else.

spans.text: No matter how you want to put it, the whole deal with us leaking secrets has spread to even here... We can't stay here any longer. If we want to survive, we'll have to make a new start someplace else.

units.rawText: Unni!
units.displayText: Unni!

spans.text: Unni!

units.rawText: Wh-what? Trying to scare me? Is something out of order with your date system? It's not Halloween today.
units.displayText: Wh-what? Trying to scare me? Is something out of order with your date system? It's not Halloween today.

spans.text: Wh-what? Trying to scare me? Is something out of order with your date system? It's not Halloween today.

units.rawText: <size=28>Well, I... don't help you out for the money.</size>
units.displayText: Well, I... don't help you out for the money.

spans.text: Well, I... don't help you out for the money.

units.rawText: (Of course I know that, but...)
units.displayText: Of course I know that, but...

spans.text: Of course I know that, but...

units.rawText: <size=28>The negative press about us is already out there. You don't want to be associated with us.</size>
units.displayText: The negative press about us is already out there. You don't want to be associated with us.

spans.text: The negative press about us is already out there. You don't want to be associated with us.

units.rawText: Ah... hehe. Everyone here is really nice, and none of your data's gonna get out. It's just...
units.displayText: Ah... hehe. Everyone here is really nice, and none of your data's gonna get out. It's just...

spans.text: Ah... hehe. Everyone here is really nice, and none of your data's gonna get out. It's just...

units.rawText: Unni, my station here ends soon, and I'll be off to a new team in a few days. I want to help more Dolls, or at least stop more things like this from happening, so I must leave.
units.displayText: Unni, my station here ends soon, and I'll be off to a new team in a few days. I want to help more Dolls, or at least stop more things like this from happening, so I must leave.

spans.text: Unni, my station here ends soon, and I'll be off to a new team in a few days. I want to help more Dolls, or at least stop more things like this from happening, so I must leave.

units.rawText: But if I don't say what I wanted to say right here and now, I might not get a chance in the future—
units.displayText: But if I don't say what I wanted to say right here and now, I might not get a chance in the future—

spans.text: But if I don't say what I wanted to say right here and now, I might not get a chance in the future—

units.rawText: Before I leave, I wanted to see you again too! I have these backup schematics, so if you plan to continue restoring their neural clouds, they might be of use.
units.displayText: Before I leave, I wanted to see you again too! I have these backup schematics, so if you plan to continue restoring their neural clouds, they might be of use.

spans.text: Before I leave, I wanted to see you again too! I have these backup schematics, so if you plan to continue restoring their neural clouds, they might be of use.

units.rawText: <size=28>De Lacey, you... you...</size>
units.displayText: De Lacey, you... you...

spans.text: De Lacey, you... you...

units.rawText: Seriously, you're as much of an idiot as every single one of them.
units.displayText: Seriously, you're as much of an idiot as every single one of them.

spans.text: Seriously, you're as much of an idiot as every single one of them.

units.rawText: Unni...
units.displayText: Unni...

spans.text: Unni...

units.rawText: De Lacey, stop worrying about me. You have your desires, as I do mine. Your desire is to help more Dolls, and my desire lies with them.
units.displayText: De Lacey, stop worrying about me. You have your desires, as I do mine. Your desire is to help more Dolls, and my desire lies with them.

spans.text: De Lacey, stop worrying about me. You have your desires, as I do mine. Your desire is to help more Dolls, and my desire lies with them.

units.rawText: Relax, I'll get by just fine, even if it's just for them.
units.displayText: Relax, I'll get by just fine, even if it's just for them.

spans.text: Relax, I'll get by just fine, even if it's just for them.

units.rawText: (Even if there's no big name sheltering us, in a brand new place there's a brand new start!)
units.displayText: Even if there's no big name sheltering us, in a brand new place there's a brand new start!

spans.text: Even if there's no big name sheltering us, in a brand new place there's a brand new start!

units.rawText: Just you wait, we used to fill up every seat in the grand opera house. If all of us are together, it'll be no problem no matter what obstacle lies in our way.
units.displayText: Just you wait, we used to fill up every seat in the grand opera house. If all of us are together, it'll be no problem no matter what obstacle lies in our way.

spans.text: Just you wait, we used to fill up every seat in the grand opera house. If all of us are together, it'll be no problem no matter what obstacle lies in our way.

units.rawText: But you, you're exactly the type of good Samaritan that's not aware in the slightest. Don't let it get you into trouble in the future.
units.displayText: But you, you're exactly the type of good Samaritan that's not aware in the slightest. Don't let it get you into trouble in the future.

spans.text: But you, you're exactly the type of good Samaritan that's not aware in the slightest. Don't let it get you into trouble in the future.

units.rawText: Okay! I'll be fine!
units.displayText: Okay! I'll be fine!

spans.text: Okay! I'll be fine!

units.rawText: <size=28>Idiot...</size>
units.displayText: Idiot...

spans.text: Idiot...

units.rawText: What? Did you just say something?
units.displayText: What? Did you just say something?

spans.text: What? Did you just say something?

units.rawText: I'm saying... Well, De Lacey...
units.displayText: I'm saying... Well, De Lacey...

spans.text: I'm saying... Well, De Lacey...

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=28>Thank you.</size></color>
units.displayText: Thank you.

spans.text: Thank you.
